title: Throttle Orchestra: workload-aware batch + cache recommender and guarded rollout
creator: Diego Martinez
description: Problem: customers continue to pay high per-token costs for workloads with variable sequence lengths and bursty arrival patterns. Current autotune systems recommend static batch sizes or broad fingerprint policies that either miss short tail-latency spikes or apply overly conservative settings. Goal: build a continuous recommendation engine that profiles live workloads, proposes per-route batching + prefix cache parameter bundles, simulates expected cost/latency impact, and applies changes using a guarded, observable rollout with automatic rollback triggers.
proposal: Implement 'Throttle Orchestra' — a recommendation engine that composes three signals: cost delta (tokens & GPU-util), latency risk (p50/p95/p99), and stability score (fingerprint drift + kernel compatibility).

Produce per-route bundles: {microbatch_size, coalescing_window_ms, kv_prefix_cache_enabled, cache_ttl_seconds, conservative_fallback_variant}. Bundles are scored with an expected cost reduction and a worst-case latency delta estimate.

Enable continuous synthesis: engine runs nightly profiling jobs plus a real-time lightweight probe that keeps a rolling 72-hour signature for each route and triggers re-proposals when workload signature shifts by >12%.

Integrate a simulation layer that replays sampled requests against candidate bundles in shadow mode (no traffic impact) to estimate p95 tail risk, throughput gains, and cost changes. Use GPU execution cost model calibrated to recent perf profiles.
Expose recommendations via Console API and a 'one-click' safe apply that implements a staged rollout: shadow -> 5% canary -> 25% -> 60% -> full, with health gates at each step.
Provide a rollback orchestration policy with automated triggers and a human-confirmation path for non-automated rollbacks.
Ship telemetry dashboards and an audit log for every recommendation and apply (who proposed, who applied, simulation score, rollback reason).
tasks: Design profile schema and stable fingerprint (engineering + research) — schema to include token histogram, interarrival distribution, kernel-compat flags.
Prototype shadow simulator that replays 1% sampled traffic against candidate bundles (no env changes).
Implement scoring function combining cost_delta_estimate, p95_risk_score, stability_score and produce ranked suggestions.
Console API and UI: recommendation view, diff of estimated metrics, accept/reject buttons, apply stage controls.
Rollout engine: orchestrate traffic shifts and health checks; integrate with existing rollout primitives (rollouts service).
Safety and rollback hooks: define automatic rollback triggers, implement circuit-breaker and manual override in Console.
E2E tests: regression tests for p95 latency, unit tests for scoring logic, canary simulation runs.
Docs and runbook: user-facing docs describing safe apply, and on-call playbook for rollbacks and post-mortems.
Privacy & security review: ensure fingerprinting is deterministic and does not leak PII; review KMS use for audit logs.
rollout_plan: Stage 0 — Shadow: run candidate bundles in shadow mode for 48-72 hours and collect simulated metrics.
Stage 1 — Canary (5%): apply to low-volume cohort; monitor latency, errors, and cost signals for 2 hours.
Stage 2 — Canary (25%): expand if Stage 1 gates pass for 24 hours.
Stage 3 — Ramp (60%): monitor 24 hours, require green across p95, error rate, and cost directionality.
Stage 4 — Full: expand to 100% with continued monitoring for 7 days and weekly re-evaluation if 'continuous' mode enabled.
Abort path: immediate rollback to previous bundle on automatic trigger or manual abort by SRE/PM/Owner.
safety_rollback_triggers: p95 latency increase > 3% absolute or > 15% relative for any affected route over 15 minutes
error rate increase > 0.2% absolute for production traffic over 5 minutes
cache_hit_rate drop > 20% causing increased tokens served
cost reduction estimate flips sign in live measurements (no cost savings observed after 6 hours)
manual abort by oncall or PM with documented reason
acceptance_criteria: Engine produces recommendations for 95% of production routes in the pilot tier
Shadow simulation estimates align with live observed metrics within a 10% margin for p95 and cost delta
Automated staged apply completes with no more than one rollback during pilot routes
Console shows diff (before/after) and audit entries for every apply
Rollout can be aborted automatically by configured triggers and manual overrides are available
Security review completed and runbook published
Performance tests show median cost-per-token savings >= 5% across pilot cohort without breaching latency SLOs
